::: {#exm-natural-numbers-recursive}
#### The natural numbers, defined recursively

The natural numbers (@def-natural-numbers) are a recursively defined set (@def-recursive-set).
The base case is $1 \in \Nat$,
and the recursive rule is that if $n \in \Nat$, then $n + 1 \in \Nat$.
The base case gives 1, one application of the rule gives $1 + 1 = 2$, a second gives $2 + 1 = 3$, and so on.
The non-negative integers (@def-nonnegative-integers) have the same recursive rule, with the base case $0 \in \Nat_0$.

:::
